Whenever Barret Wallace attacks, it deals damage equal to the number of equipped creatures you control to defending player.
blocked_sentences: Whenever Barret Wallace attacks, it deals damage equal to the number of equipped creatures you control to defending player.

needs.what: a selector key matching a creature that has one or more Equipment attached to it (by anybody's Equipment), e.g. {"equipped": true}, usable inside a `count` value so "the number of equipped creatures you control" is {"count": {"types": ["Creature"], "controller": "you", "equipped": true}}
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `attached` matches only the object the ability's own source is attached to (Equipment -> its creature), not any creature carrying an Equipment; `enchanted_by` asks about Auras only (aura_controllers skips non-Auras); `modified` also counts creatures with counters or your Auras, so it would overcount; `attached_to` filters the attachment's host from the attachment's side, not the host's side. The rest of the line (attacks trigger, damage with defender_of self) is already expressible
